class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Generate &amp; edit images with Gemini Apps</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div class="no-margin"><p>You can create captivating images in seconds with Nano Banana 2. From work, play, or anything in between, Gemini Apps can help you generate and refine images to help bring your imagination to life. For paid subscribers, Nano Banana Pro is also available to regenerate images.</p>
</div>

<div><p><strong>Important: </strong>When you generate images with Gemini Apps, remember that you agreed to Google's <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Terms of Service</a>, including the <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Prohibited Use Policy</a>. Be sure not to violate others' copyright or privacy rights. Use your discretion before you rely on, publish, or use content that Gemini Apps generate.&nbsp;Users with a work or school account may be subject to different terms depending on the license type. Learn more about how to <a href="/gemini/answer/14620100" rel="noopener">use Gemini Apps with your work or school Google Account</a>.</p>

<h2>What you need</h2>

<ul class="no-margin">
  <li>This feature’s availability in any specific Gemini app is also limited to the supported languages and countries of that app.</li>
  <li>
    <div class="no-margin"><p>To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</p>
</div>
  </li>
</ul>

<ul class="no-margin">
  <li>To meet the age requirements to use this feature with a personal account.
    <ul>
      <li>To generate and edit images, you must be 18 or over</li>
      <li>To generate images, you must be 13 (or the <a href="/accounts/answer/1350409" rel="noopener">applicable age in your country</a>) or over.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>If you are signed in to a school account, you may be subject to different access restrictions.</li>
</ul>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>

<h3>Key features of Nano Banana 2</h3>

<div><ul>
  <li><strong>Improved world knowledge:</strong> create diagrams and infographics with more accurate info.</li>
  <li><strong>Character consistency:</strong> Maintain the look of a person or character across various generated images, including the ability to combine multiple images to blend scenes or ideas.</li>
  <li><strong>Local edits:</strong> Making quick and specific changes to parts of an image.</li>
  <li><strong>Better text rendering:</strong> Add&nbsp;text to images with more accurate spelling, for all supported languages.</li>
  <li><strong>Enhanced instruction following: </strong>The model can follow more complex requests, to capture details.</li>
  <li><strong>High output quality:</strong>&nbsp;Preview images&nbsp;at high resolution.&nbsp;Download images at at 2K resolution with a Google AI plan or&nbsp;at 1K without an AI plan.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Tips:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>Nano Banana 2 is ideal to create personalized images such as when you want to view yourself with different hairstyles, picture yourself in different scenes or create memes.</li>
</ul>

<div class="no-margin"><ul>
  <li>If you’re in the US and meet other requirements, Nano Banana 2 can also use Personal Intelligence to create and edit images tailored entirely to you. <a href="#image_pi" rel="noopener">Learn how Gemini personalizes images with Personal Intelligence</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>

<h2>About Nano Banana models</h2>

<div>To use a different Nano Banana model, switch your Gemini model before you create your image request. &nbsp;<a href="/gemini/answer/14517446#switch_model" rel="noopener">Learn how to switch models</a>.</div>

<div>Nano Banana offers different models designed for various needs.
<ul>
  <li><strong>Nano Banana 2 Lite:</strong> This option is used when the Gemini model is set to Flash-Lite. It &nbsp;is optimized for speed. It is ideal for quick images and basic ideas. It isn’t designed for multiple image references or for multiple edits.</li>
  <li><strong>Nano Banana 2:</strong> This option is selected when you make an image request with the Gemini model set to Flash or Pro. It &nbsp;balances speed with higher image quality, more world knowledge, and reliable text rendering. It can accept multiple reference images.</li>
  <li><strong>Nano Banana Pro:</strong> Available with a Google AI Plan, this option is available when you have the Gemini model set to Pro and want &nbsp;to redo an image when additional detail is needed. It has the highest level of world knowledge, advanced text and language capabilities, higher consistency, and more precise creative control.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<gkms-context-selector id="14286263"></gkms-context-selector><h2 id="gen_images">Generate &amp; review images</h2>

<div><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>On the top left, click Open Sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Images <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/89DsAult6Ft4lgciJAYamizXtdQOdnY4hu5ygNqTheUAsTxu7A5I2Sz3SnmFPmExcdUG=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/89DsAult6Ft4lgciJAYamizXtdQOdnY4hu5ygNqTheUAsTxu7A5I2Sz3SnmFPmExcdUG">.</li>
  <li>Choose a template or enter your prompt to generate an image with Nano Banana 2. Check <a href="#tips" rel="noopener">tips for image generation prompts</a>.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h3>Examples</h3>

<div><ul>
  <li>Generate an image of a futuristic car driving through an old mountain road surrounded by nature</li>
  <li>Create an image of a dog riding a surfboard</li>
  <li>Create an&nbsp;image&nbsp;of a jungle with a river in a splashy watercolor style</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div>
  <h2>Create and use an avatar with Nano Banana</h2>

  <div><p>You can record your face and voice to create your avatar to use when you create images with Nano Banana.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Your avatar lets you create custom images or yourself without the need to upload a photo each time. &nbsp;</p>

<p><a href="/gemini/answer/16984474" rel="noopener">Learn how to create and use an avatar in Gemini Apps</a>.<br>
  &nbsp;</p>
</div>

  <h2>Edit images with Nano Banana 2</h2>
</div>

<div><p><strong>Important: </strong>Editing images isn't available to users under 18.</p>

<p>With Nano Banana 2, there are a few ways that you can edit images. For example, you can:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Edit an image that you generated in Gemini Apps.</li>
  <li>Upload an image and ask Gemini to make edits.</li>
  <li>Upload multiple images and ask Gemini to create a new image based on your uploaded images.</li>
</ul>
<a href="https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Find examples of how you can edit images</a>.</div>

<div><ol>
  <li>Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>On the top left, click Open Sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Library&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/WRsInaQpivOozOfq80Dyd7IW076K9GOv6g-57ZvK2M8VMQYG5eGfiEOuKAfUy8WTcew=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/WRsInaQpivOozOfq80Dyd7IW076K9GOv6g-57ZvK2M8VMQYG5eGfiEOuKAfUy8WTcew">.</li>
  <li>Find the image you want to edit and click&nbsp;it.&nbsp;
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Tip: </strong>You can also&nbsp;upload an image to edit.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Under the image, click Chat&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/38FtHe4tdtHxvS2EbXr4yjd8w6ijvWdtLk3dlSejXYBCSMaJlSbkFNKpZoiwUrHPIeU=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/38FtHe4tdtHxvS2EbXr4yjd8w6ijvWdtLk3dlSejXYBCSMaJlSbkFNKpZoiwUrHPIeU"></li>
  <li>In the text box at the bottom, enter your prompt.
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Tip:</strong> You can upload an image to edit or ask Gemini to edit a generated image.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click Submit <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h2><a id="redo_image" name="redo_image">Redo an image with Nano Banana Pro</a></h2>

<div><p>Paid subscribers can use Nano Banana Pro to regenerate an image. Nano Banana Pro can provide additional detail, especially for images that use text rendering or for infographics. To use Nano Banana Pro:</p>

<ol>
  <li>Create an image with Nano Banana 2 or Nano Banana 2 Lite. &nbsp;</li>
  <li>At the bottom right, click More&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva">&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> &nbsp;<strong>Redo with Pro</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<div><strong>Important:</strong> &nbsp;If you reach your daily quota of Nano Banana 2 images, you can’t redo any additional images with Nano Banana Pro.</div>

<h2><a id="connect-photos" name="connect-photos"></a>Connect Google Photos to edit &amp; transform photos</h2>

<div><strong>Important:</strong> This feature is only available to users 18 and over in the US. You must be signed in to your personal Google Account to use it. The Google Photos connected app currently isn’t available in some US regions.</div>

<div>To use Nano Banana to edit and transform your photos, you can connect Google Photos to Gemini Apps to easily access your photos. To connect Google Photos:</div>

<div><a class="zippy" id="p13n_photos-web_app" name="p13n_photos-web_app">In the Gemini web app</a>
<div>
  <ol>
    <li>On your computer, go to <a href="gemini.google.com" rel="noopener">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
    <li>At the bottom, click Settings &amp; help <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8">&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Personal Intelligence</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;<strong>Connected Apps</strong>.</li>
    <li>Turn on Google Photos <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lZNk4wixysLqHjNdhExHJly88zo6snR8S0m6yyBdHs-g4QstlXBgfdxJPYMXgbWEYXE=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Photos" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lZNk4wixysLqHjNdhExHJly88zo6snR8S0m6yyBdHs-g4QstlXBgfdxJPYMXgbWEYXE">.&nbsp;</li>
    <li>Follow the on-screen instructions.</li>
  </ol>

  <p><a class="btn btn-raised" href="https://gemini.google.com/apps">Go to Connected Apps settings</a></p>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="p13n_photos-gic" name="p13n_photos-gic">In the Gemini in Chrome</a>

<div>
  <ol>
    <li>On your computer, open Chrome.</li>
    <li>At the top of Gemini in Chrome, click More options <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva">&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Settings &amp; help <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/RjsOMXt3uEsODQKhsAhHIBr8PLqFtq4ceh5q-jtovHQbSgkSw_YTqEsIkpMFcgUtA5FK=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/RjsOMXt3uEsODQKhsAhHIBr8PLqFtq4ceh5q-jtovHQbSgkSw_YTqEsIkpMFcgUtA5FK">&nbsp;<strong>Personal Intelligence</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"><strong>&nbsp;Connected Apps</strong>.</li>
    <li>Turn on Google Photos <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lZNk4wixysLqHjNdhExHJly88zo6snR8S0m6yyBdHs-g4QstlXBgfdxJPYMXgbWEYXE=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Photos" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lZNk4wixysLqHjNdhExHJly88zo6snR8S0m6yyBdHs-g4QstlXBgfdxJPYMXgbWEYXE">.&nbsp;</li>
    <li>Follow the on-screen instructions.</li>
  </ol>

  <p><a class="btn btn-raised" href="https://gemini.google.com/apps">Go to Connected Apps settings</a></p>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="download">Download, share, or export a generated image</h2>

<div><h4>To download an image:</h4>

<p>Hover over the image you want to download, and click Download full size <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/owOYUdNA_UfwIH6RlO0aQ8hDOBIKB0ru51YB9r9ZfXCvZvM8k_yeZssIYLGD0P9tNSI=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/owOYUdNA_UfwIH6RlO0aQ8hDOBIKB0ru51YB9r9ZfXCvZvM8k_yeZssIYLGD0P9tNSI"></p>

<h4>To export an image:&nbsp;</h4>

<ol>
  <li>Under the image, click More&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva">&nbsp;.</li>
  <li>Click Export to Docs&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/v4J8kBQH2vIGX1Mfv7trThykKZHer-XrMN6rYKyRxnC_qtFGJcDFOHSCHFyq_ppzLVa6=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/v4J8kBQH2vIGX1Mfv7trThykKZHer-XrMN6rYKyRxnC_qtFGJcDFOHSCHFyq_ppzLVa6">.</li>
  <li>Open the doc to continue editing.</li>
</ol>

<p><strong>Important: </strong>Users under 18 on a school account won’t be able to export to Docs.</p>
</div>



<h2 id="tips">Tips for image generation prompts</h2>

<div><ul>
  <li>Start your prompt with words like draw, generate, and create.</li>
  <li>Describe the image style you want. Here are a few examples: photorealistic, charcoal drawing, watercolor painting, cartoon illustration.</li>
  <li>Include a detailed visual description of what you want in the image. This can include the subject of the image, what the subject is doing, and the background or setting.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2><a id="image_pi" name="image_pi"></a>How image generation works with Personal Intelligence</h2>

<div><strong>Important:</strong> Nano Banana with Personal Intelligence is only available to users 18 and over in the US. To use this feature, you must sign in to a personal Google Account. The Google Photos connected app currently isn’t available in some US regions.</div>

<div><p>You can ask Gemini to create or edit highly personalized images using Personal Intelligence. With your permission, Gemini can understand and retrieve info across your Google apps, past chats, and more to understand your unique style, life, and preferences. It then uses the latest Nano Banana model to create and edit images tailored entirely to you.</p>

<p>Try these example prompts:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Create a watercolor image of my dream house nestled in my favorite setting.</li>
  <li>Create a claymation image of me and my family enjoying our favorite activity. We want to be standing in the center of the image, staring straight forward.
    <ul>
      <li>This example requires Google Photos to be connected to Gemini Apps. <a href="#connect-photos" rel="noopener">Learn how to connect Google Photos</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

<p>Gemini can use the labels you’ve set up in Google Photos to identify people and pets to generate images of them with Nano Banana.<br>
  <br>
  <strong>Tip:</strong> To create images of other people from your Google Photos, make sure their face group is named. <a href="/gemini/answer/13695044?" rel="noopener">Learn how to set up and manage your face groups</a>.</p>

<p>Personal Intelligence experiences are optional. You can choose which Google apps to connect, manage how your past chats are used, and set your own instructions. <a href="/gemini/answer/16598623" rel="noopener">Learn how to manage Personal Intelligence in Gemini Apps</a>.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="why_image_removed">Why Gemini Apps might remove an image</h2>

<div><p>Gemini Apps may remove images for prompts when our systems detect a possible violation of Google's <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Terms of Service</a>, including the <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Prohibited Use Policy</a>.</p>

<p>Users with a work or school account may be subject to different terms. Learn more about how to <a href="/gemini/answer/14620100" rel="noopener">use Gemini Apps with your work or school Google Account</a>.</p>
</div>

</ul>
